reply_now.name: Jerry Liu
reply_now.reply_draft: Voice dumps context well. The agent brief still needs keyboard precision: file paths, constraints, and which three lines to touch. If voice does not cut your time from wrong output to corrected re-prompt, it is not the bottleneck.

reply_now.name: Ethan Mollick
reply_now.reply_draft: Benchmarks miss the expensive part: how often the model guesses instead of asking, and how wide it rewrites on a small ask. Keep a 10-ticket feel suite from your own repo and re-run it on every model bump.

reply_now.name: Ethan Mollick
reply_now.reply_draft: Same pattern shows up in software agents: language plans the job, but you still need a small skill API and a memory of the world. When an agent almost works, I check missing skills or memory before I chase a bigger model.

reply_now.name: Shreya Shankar
reply_now.reply_draft: The hard part of mixing decode into prefill is length estimation under uncertainty. Cap open-ended MAP outputs, budget the worst case, and only then try to hide decode under document reading. Wrong length guesses trash the schedule.

reply_now.name: Shreya Shankar
reply_now.reply_draft: Building with agents on top of battle-tested infra is the right default. Credit the foundations in the README and keep a human gate on anything that changes correctness or the speed-of-light budget.

reply_now.name: jason
reply_now.reply_draft: Yes, if Instructor stays the schema layer and Jev is just another backend for bounded decisions. Same Pydantic shape, swap the engine when volume or latency demands it.

reply_now.name: Hamel Husain
reply_now.reply_draft: Agree. Log product pain before you argue root cause. I keep a single failure ledger with columns for symptom, user impact, and suspected layer. Model vs tool vs spec gets sorted after the row exists.

reply_now.name: Jerry Liu
reply_now.reply_draft: WPM is a proxy for steering speed. The metric I watch is seconds from bad agent output to corrected instruction. Templates for fix/review/explain cut that loop more than another model upgrade.
